name: Object-Centric Petri Net Discovery
description: Discovers an Object-Centric Petri Net from an OCEL 2.0 log: per selected object type, project the log, mine a process tree with Inductive Miner, convert it to a Petri net, then merge every object type's net by shared activity. One action, selectable directly on the OCEL log — the projection this needs runs transparently as its own internal stage.

objectTypes.title: Object types
objectTypes.description: Which object types participate in discovery. Empty means every object type present in the log.

optionsFrom.sql: SELECT object_type AS value, COUNT(*) AS n FROM {object} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC

variableMultiplicity.title: Variable-arc pairs
variableMultiplicity.description: Filled in automatically from the log's own internal projection step — (object type, activity) pairs where at least one event touched more than one object of that type. Not user-editable.

minerVariant.title: Miner variant
minerVariant.description: IM guarantees every object type's lifecycle replays every trace it was discovered from. IMf gives that up in exchange for ignoring infrequent behavior, and is the usual choice on a real log.

noiseThreshold.title: Noise threshold
noiseThreshold.description: IMf only. How weak a path has to be, relative to the strongest alternative, before it is treated as noise. Applied independently within each object type's own lifecycle.

citation.text: van der Aalst, W.M.P., Berti, A. (2020). Discovering Object-centric Petri Nets. Fundamenta Informaticae, 175(1-4), 1-40.
